row.title: models.github.ai answers every request with 200 text/plain OK (2026-11-19)
row.body: Measured from GitHub Actions and from a workstation: /inference/chat/completions, /orgs/<org>/inference/chat/completions and /catalog/models all return HTTP 200 text/plain 'OK'. The GitHub Models rungs are dead; LADDER-FALLTHROUGH-1 makes a dead rung pass to the next live rung within the same attempt and passes reviewers on a dead route to the next family.
